scenes.ill_rummage_sale: 1968 Seattle: a school gymnasium turned into a parents' rummage sale, mothers in 1960s dresses selling old lamps, books and toys at folding tables, a metal cash box filling with dollar bills, rain outside the tall windows
scenes.ill_teacher: 1968 high school classroom: a middle-aged math teacher with a crew cut, a former navy pilot (a small framed photo of a WWII navy plane on his desk), pointing at equations on a chalkboard, students in 1960s clothes
scenes.ill_terminal_room: 1968: a small cramped school room with one clunky teletype computer terminal on a table, two skinny teenage boys in sweaters hunched over it, long yellowed paper printout spilling onto the floor, dusk light through the window
scenes.ill_night_coding: Late at night in a dark school room lit only by a desk lamp: a teenage boy's hands typing on a teletype keyboard while printed paper scrolls out, the clock on the wall shows late hour, intense focus
scenes.ill_magazine_dream: Late at night: one teenage boy in glasses holds up a business magazine (cover blank, no text) to his older teenage friend, both sitting on the floor of a school computer room, the glow of possibility on their faces
scenes.ill_sea_students: An enormous sea of high school students from all over the world seen from above, stretching to the horizon, one tiny figure lit by a single warm spotlight in the middle
scenes.ill_lit_window: Night view over an endless dark landscape of millions of tiny houses, only one single school window glows warm yellow in the middle, sense of extreme rarity
scenes.ill_phone_bed: 1969 teenage boy's bedroom: a boy lying on his bed with his feet up the wall, talking happily on a rotary phone with a very long curly cord, posters and books around
scenes.ill_schedule: 1971: two teenage boys at a school office desk buried in piles of class schedule cards, punch cards and a large hand-drawn timetable grid on the wall, solving a puzzle together
scenes.ill_briefcase: 1971 high school hallway: a confident teenage boy in a blazer carrying an oversized leather lawyer's briefcase, walking ahead of his friend, lockers on both sides
scenes.ill_dreams: Two teenage boys sitting on a grassy hill above a city at sunset, talking about the future; in the clouds above them faint dreamy silhouettes of a CEO at a desk, a general with medals and an ambassador shaking hands
scenes.ill_climb_class: Spring 1972: a small group of young climbers in helmets roped together on a steep snowy mountain slope in Washington state, an instructor ahead, dramatic peaks and clouds, sense of quiet danger
scenes.ill_empty_desk: An empty classroom desk by a window in spring, a closed leather briefcase resting on it, dust in the light, a feeling of absence and grief
scenes.ill_bad_news: 1972: a teenage boy at home holding a rotary phone receiver, frozen in shock, the rest of the house dim, rain on the window
scenes.ill_twins: Two identical twin silhouettes standing back to back, one bathed in warm golden sunlight, the other in cold blue shadow, same height, same shape, symbolic
scenes.ill_wheel: A giant old carnival wheel of fortune spinning at night, one half of the wheel painted golden sunlight, the other half dark storm, two small boys watching it from opposite sides
scenes.ill_brothers: Two adult brothers in similar suits standing proudly in front of a wealthy family mansion, behind them a faint ghost image of the same two boys as children at an expensive private school
scenes.ill_flat_stock: A man in his thirties at his desk staring at a flat sideways line on an old computer monitor, calendar pages flying away behind him to show five years passing, puzzled expression
scenes.ill_blame: Split scene: on the left, a man points a judging finger at a stranger who tripped and fell; on the right, the same man after his own fall blames dark storm clouds above him, ironic
scenes.ill_newsstand: A big city newsstand wall covered with dozens of glossy business magazine covers, each showing a smiling confident tycoon portrait (no text, no letters), a passerby looking up in admiration
scenes.ill_coin_toss: Two businessmen flipping coins side by side, one coin lands in a beam of golden light and the man becomes surrounded by money, the other coin falls into shadow, slow motion feeling
scenes.ill_vanderbilt_office: 1860s New York office: a stern old railroad tycoon with white sideburns seen from behind and in partial profile, waving away a nervous young advisor holding legal papers, steam locomotives visible through the tall window
scenes.ill_railroad_build: 1860s America: workers laying railroad tracks across open land, a black steam locomotive with a big smokestack puffing smoke, a powerful tycoon on horseback watching from a hill
scenes.ill_courtroom: 1870s courtroom: a railroad tycoon in a dark suit standing before a stern judge, newspapermen scribbling, an alternate fate where he lost everything
scenes.ill_enron_boxes: 2001: office employees carrying cardboard boxes out of a gleaming glass corporate tower, a sad crowd and news cameras outside, overcast sky
scenes.ill_graham_desk: 1948 Manhattan office: a bespectacled investment professor at his desk looking at one huge tall stack of insurance company stock certificates towering over many small neat piles of other certificates, thoughtful
scenes.ill_boardroom_2006: 2006: a young founder in a hoodie and sandals calmly shaking his head at a conference table, across from him serious executives in suits pushing a big check forward, his own team behind him looking anxious
scenes.ill_rejected_bid: 2008: a corporate executive in a glass office pushing back an enormous oversized check across a long table, rival executives on the other side stunned
scenes.ill_tightrope: A tightrope walker crossing between two cliffs at sunset; on one side of the rope a crowd cheers, on the other side a dark abyss, the rope is almost invisible, thin line between bold and reckless
scenes.ill_letter_son: A father writing a long letter by lamplight at a desk at night, a newborn baby asleep in a crib beside him, gentle and warm
scenes.ill_three_births: Triptych: a newborn baby in a wealthy home full of books, a newborn in a busy hopeful city apartment, a newborn in a poor village in a troubled place, each with a parent holding them
scenes.ill_spotlight: A billionaire on a bright stage under a single spotlight, an audience of thousands taking notes in the dark, but behind the curtain a huge invisible crowd of people who tried the same and failed
scenes.ill_free_morning: An ordinary person walking slowly through a sunny park on a weekday morning with a coffee, no rush, relaxed smile, others rushing to work in the distance
scenes.ill_pedestal: A smug confident man standing tall on a high marble pedestal, not noticing that the pedestal is cracking at the base
scenes.ill_safety_net: A trapeze artist falling calmly into a strong safety net below, the crowd relieved, ready to climb back up
scenes.ill_bench_dusk: A person sitting alone on a park bench at dusk, gently resting a hand on their own shoulder, looking at the orange horizon, calm self-forgiveness
scenes.ill_wait_rain: A person standing with an umbrella in the rain on a hill, sunlight breaking through the clouds in the distance, patient and hopeful
scenes.ill_two_paths: Two teenage boys standing at a fork in a mountain trail, one path leading down to a sunny valley city, the other path disappearing into fog and snow, seen from behind
